name: Kevin Douglas
bio: Kevin Douglas aka KZA, a 25-year-old American-Guyanese Director, Producer, and Editor hailing from NYC, embarked on his filmmaking journey at the age of 15. With a wealth of experience and a passion for emotional cinematic storytelling, KZA’s vision seamlessly blends action, surrealism, and compelling acting to captivate audiences. KZA has worked on a plethora of music videos, commercials, and branded content, with aspirations to make narrative films. His creative journey unfolds on the vibrant canvas of New York City, where he continues to carve his niche in the world of filmmaking.
